title: [ingest] Benchmark verdict: graph cost is cache_read, not work — measure with output_tokens
summary: The ON-vs-OFF token study found actual work (output_tokens) is at parity with/without the graph; the entire cost delta is cache_read of loaded context. Compact payloads brought gross cost from 1.63x (v2 fat) to 1.03x (v3 lean). Always measure work with output_tokens, NOT gross-minus-plumbing 'net' (a metric artifact).
